scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Oh?
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
哦？
你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
We're in trouble~~
We can't have anyone know we're here~~
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
糟糕了~~
我们不能让任何人知道我们在这里~~

scripts.text:
[Dien]
The adventurer is here too!
Why are you scared!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
冒险者也在这里！
你怕什么！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Hello {0}.
We've came here to do something... It was too troublesome to tell the youngsters.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你好，{0}。
我们来这里是为了做点事... 告诉那些小家伙太麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
If you keep it a secret that you saw us...
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
如果你能保守秘密，不说你看到了我们...

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Sister~~
What are you talking about, I don't see the adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
姐姐~~
你在说什么，我没看到冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Oh~
Yeah?
I don't see the adventurer either~
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
哦~
是吗？
我也没看到冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
So what now?
We're already inside.
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
那现在怎么办？
我们已经进来了。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
It can't be helped~~
We have to go with the adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
没办法了~~
我们得和冒险者一起走。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's dangerous, so please come with us.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
这里很危险，请跟我们走。

scripts.text: - There is a pipe going through the floor. -
scripts.translation: - 地板下有一根管道穿过。 -

scripts.text: Crush it.
scripts.translation: 砸碎它

scripts.text: Put it down.
scripts.translation: 放下

scripts.text: - Nothing happened. -
scripts.translation: - 什么也没发生。 -

scripts.text: - The machine stopped with a strange noise when the pipe was broken. -
scripts.translation: - 管道断裂时，机器发出奇怪的噪音停止了。 -

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh my! What's that thing in the front?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
天哪！前面那个是什么东西？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh my! I think it's precise device that's placed here in the abandoned mine.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
天哪！我想这是放置在这座废弃矿坑里的精密装置。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
If you don't break the machine on the other side, we will not be able pass it!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
如果你不破坏另一边的机器，我们就无法通过！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's dangerous to go through right now, so let's turn around and go where the device is!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
现在过去很危险，我们折返去装置那里吧！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh!
If you go to the right, I think you can go back on the railroad without having to break the door.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！
如果你往右走，我想可以不破坏门就回到铁轨上。

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Oh, is this gate too hard?
It will take some time to break it~
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
哎呀，这扇门很难破吗？
要弄坏它得花点时间呢~

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh!
If you go to the right, I think you can go back on the railroad without having to break the door.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！
如果你往右走，我想可以不破坏门就回到铁轨上。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Argh!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
可恶！

scripts.text:
[Est]
Oh...
I'm in a hurry, what are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
哦...
我赶时间，你们在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Est]
Please go back and enjoy your tea gracefully.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
请回去优雅地享用你们的茶吧。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Huh!
How did you sneak in here anyway?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
哼！
你们是怎么偷偷溜进来的？

scripts.text:
[Est]
This is only a surveillance routine.
If you close your eyes for a second, you may run into an accident.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
这只是例行监视。
如果你们稍微疏忽大意，可能会出事故的。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
What makes you think we need your help?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
谁需要你们的帮助了？

scripts.text:
[Est]
Didn't you just did now?
I don't think I heard that wrong. Did I?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
刚才不是你们自己说的吗？
我耳朵没聋，听错了？

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
You two really~
Please stop fighting.
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
你们两个真是~
请别吵架了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
How do you always fight like that?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你们怎么总是这样吵架？

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
I'm so excited about this~ I'm getting old and I'm tired of fighting.
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
我对此很兴奋~ 我年纪大了，厌倦了战斗。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Is that so?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
是吗？

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Yeah~
I'm tired of fighting, let's go back to work.
The road is open now.
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
是啊~
我厌倦了战斗，我们回去工作吧。
路已经通了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Finally..
If you cross this door...
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
终于...
穿过这扇门...

scripts.text:
[Est]
Let's head back now before they gather more troops.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
趁他们还没集结更多兵力，我们赶紧回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
打扰一下。

scripts.text:
[Est]
?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh my, oh my!
What should we do!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
天哪，天哪！
我们该怎么办！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Why, what's going on?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
为什么，发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I think I've left it.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我想我把它落下了。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Left what?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
落下什么了？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
My protection charm!
I get nervous if I don't have it with me.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我的护身符！
如果没带在身上，我会很不安的。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
You've been fine so far without it?!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
你之前没带它不也挺好的吗？！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
...

[Ridsh]
Ah... Sorry..
Alright.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
啊...抱歉..
好吧。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
While we open the last door, would you mind going back to ^FF0000Clana Nemieri^000000?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
趁我们打开最后一扇门的时候，你介意去一趟^FF0000夜巡者转职考试地点^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
I have to contact a few people anyway, and Dien won't go anywhere until she gets her protection charm.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
反正我也得联系几个人，而且迪恩在拿到护身符之前是不会走的。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Sister, tell me where it is.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
姐姐，告诉我它在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh!
Thank you so much for that
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！
太感谢你了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's hard for me to get it back because it's far...
Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
因为地方很远，我自己去拿很困难...
请帮个忙。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
^FF0000Go back to my room and look for a chest on the left side of the window, near a vase.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
^FF0000回到我的房间，在窗户左侧、花瓶附近找一个箱子。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It should be easy to get since we're here.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
既然我们在这里，应该很容易拿到。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Oh!
Shouldn't we tell them where we are?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
哦！
我们是不是该告诉他们在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
It's good sometimes to take a quick walk like this~
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
偶尔像这样散散步也不错~

scripts.text:
[Est]
I eager to explore the area beyond here.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我很想探索这里以外的地方。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
I'm tired!
I want to go home.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
我累了！
我想回家。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It would be better to just go around the door.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
最好还是绕着门走。
